idea-plugin.name: Credit Optimizer
idea-plugin.description: A local index of your microservice repos, so factual questions (a route's contract, who consumes a topic, which bean implements an interface) are answered instantly for free, and only genuine generation tasks reach Copilot Chat, with a minimal, exact bundle instead of whole files. Everything is local-per-developer — no server, no shared index, no MCP.

action.description: Ask a factual question, answered from the local index when possible, before it ever reaches Copilot
